name: One-Hand Push Pass at Game Speed
setup: Stand two to three metres from a wall, ball at the chest, a target marked on the wall.
cues: Full game speed now: if your form slips, drop back to the slower version.
Step and push the ball off one hand to the target, the other hand guiding.
Step toward the target as the ball leaves.

faults.fix: Step and snap: the ball should hit the target on a flat line.
Step toward the target on the floor every pass.

name: Outlet Pass at Game Speed
setup: Rebound position under the basket, a partner or a target up the side of the floor.
cues: Full game speed now: if your form slips, drop back to the slower version.
Pivot to the outside and throw the ball overhead to the target up the floor.
Step toward the target as the ball leaves.

faults.fix: Step and snap: the ball should hit the target on a flat line.
Step toward the target on the floor every pass.
